title: Quenched Thai Mentaiko Larb
description: Resinous, snappy, and bursting with umami flavors, this quenched Thai Mentaiko Larb is a unique twist on the traditional Larb. The crunch of katsuramuki-cut vegetables pairs perfectly with the creamy richness of mentaiko.
instructions: Heat a saucepan over medium-high heat and add 1 tsp of vegetable oil.
Add the katsuramuki-cut carrots and khasian pepper to the saucepan and cook until the carrots start to soften, about 3 minutes.
Add the katsuramuki-cut red bell peppers and continue cooking for another 2 minutes.
Add the chili flakes and brown sugar to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked mentaiko to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Pour in the Thai sticky rice vinegar, fish sauce, and lime juice into the saucepan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked mixture to a serving bowl and garnish with fresh cilantro, chili slices, and Thai basil.
Serve the Quenched Thai Mentaiko Larb immediately and enjoy!
